{{Quote|The silooth are mutated from beetles. Long ago, the Sith scattered them across the world of Kalsunor. The click of their mandible became a dire drumbeat. These tank-sized scavengers can still be found on the planet, melting its ruined cities with sprays of acid. The Sith keep swarms of them in reserve for another campaign.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''silooth''' was a large [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] beetle [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] for use as a warbeast. Silooth were ferocious creatures that relentlessly attacked anyone or anything that strayed into their paths, spraying [[Acid/Legends|acid]] and using their powerful [[Mouth/Legends|mandibles]] to crush their victims. The only deployment of the silooth in [[Ground warfare/Legends|combat]] en masse was during the [[Battle of Kalsunor]], when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] released the creatures on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalsunor]] and subsequently laid waste to the world. Afterward, the Sith continued to use the beetles on a smaller scale, and descendants of silooth transported to Kalsunor continued to inhabit the world thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.

==Biology and appearance==
The silooth was a large, [[Armor/Legends|armored]]<ref name="TDSS" /> [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] beetle<ref name="BoS" /> that was [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], an interstellar fiefdom<ref name="TDSS" /> located within the [[Stygian Caldera]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In their [[Silooth precursor species|natural state]], the silooth were no bigger than a [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]], but as a result of mutation via [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], they were enlarged to the size of a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]],<ref name="TDSS" /> a common [[Desert/Legends|desert]] herd beast.<ref name="TWoSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> A silooth had six [[Limb/Legends|legs]],<ref name="BoS" /><ref name="JATM" /> and its body was covered in a set of<ref name="TDSS" /> [[Color/Legends|brown]]-colored,<ref name="JATM" /> segmented [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]] plates that served as a form of [[Chitin armor|armor]]<ref name="TDSS" /> and were artificially thickened as a result of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] manipulations. The carapace was covered by a set of chitinous points, and the creature's head was situated at the front of the carapace. The head featured two yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a large [[Mouth/Legends|jaw]] containing a set of yellowish, jagged [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]],<ref name="JATM" /> with mandibles strong enough to crush most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.<ref name="TDSS" />

The silooth was adapted for [[Ground warfare/Legends|battle]], and each leg of the creature ended in a set of razor-sharp claws. The beetle was also capable of spewing [[Acid/Legends|acid]] from its mouth, spraying the substance at targets up to ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away. The acid was produced by a series of sacs contained within the creature's maw; when it felt enraged or threatened, the silooth flexed its muscles to empty the contents of two internal sacs containing inert liquids into a third sac, where the two liquids combined to form a powerful acid. The third sac then contracted to spray the acid, and the beetle then could not spew the substance again for a short [[Time/Legends|time]] until the sacs refueled. While they possessed excellent low-light vision, a silooth was not capable of seeing further than ten meters in front of itself, even during [[Standard day/Legends|daytime]].<ref name="TDSS" />

==Behavior==
[[File:Silooth.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Sith bred the silooth to be predatory and ferocious.]]
The silooth were non-sentient creatures. Though in their natural state the creatures were docile<ref name="TDSS" /> [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]<ref name="JATM" /> beetles,<ref name="BoS" /> the Sith altered them to make them predatory and ferocious, with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] fueling their rage. A silooth relentlessly attacked anyone and anything that crossed its path and did not stop until whatever it was that had disturbed it was [[Death/Legends|dead]] or destroyed. The creatures clacked their mandibles loudly before attacking and commonly fought by spraying acid and crushing enemies with their jaws. Silooth were difficult to control, and even their Sith creators found it hard to restrain the giant beetles.<ref name="TDSS" />

==History==
{{Quote|During the same war that birthed the silooth, the Sith introduced the warbird and the war behemoth.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
Created from a smaller [[Species/Legends|species]] of beetle via the means of Sith alchemy, the silooth were bred by the [[Kissai]] [[Ninûshwodzakut]]&mdash;a group of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] tasked with the creation of warbeasts&mdash;for use during a [[Unidentified war (Sith Empire)|conflict]] in which the Empire had became embroiled.<ref name="BoS" /> The silooth subsequently received their combat debut during the [[Battle of Kalsunor]], when they were released en masse on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalsunor]] to breach the defenses of the world's [[City/Legends|cities]] and to wreak havoc and destruction. The plan was a success, with the silooth causing chaos and laying waste to the planet, allowing a force of Sith warriors sent in behind them to bring the battle to a conclusion and complete the victory for the Sith. However, in the aftermath of the battle, the Sith forces struggled to control the marauding silooth, and the Sith abandoned the world, leaving the beetles behind.<ref name="TDSS" />

By the time of the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] to the Empire<ref name="BoS" /> in around [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Sith held swarms of silooth in reserve in case they were needed during a future conflict. Furthermore, the Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sith alchemist/Legends|alchemist]] [[Sorzus Syn]] mentioned the creatures in [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]] of her encounters with the Sith.<ref name="BoS" /> However, the creatures ultimately ceased to see mainstream use by the Sith military, and the Battle of Kalsunor remained their only mass deployment. Records of the secret of silooth manipulation were kept within certain [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]], and, for the remainder of the history of the Sith Empire, it was not uncommon for one or two silooth to be in existence at any one time.<ref name="TDSS" />

==Silooth in the galaxy==
An [[Army/Legends|army]] of silooth was left behind on the planet Kalsunor following the battle there, and for millennia afterward their descendants continued to prey upon whatever other creatures and beings they encountered.<ref name="TDSS" /> Kalsunor was not in the databases of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the exact location of the planet was unknown to the majority of the population of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], though rumors circulated among [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] of a world overrun by creatures that matched the description of the silooth.<ref name="JATM" /> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] named [[Silooth (Star Destroyer)|''Silooth'']] saw service within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], under the command of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Peccati Syn]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The silooth was first mentioned in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] supplement ''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]'', by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[J.D. Wiker]],<ref name="TDSS" /> and it later received an entry within the compendium ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|152|silooth}}</ref> The creature was subsequently expanded upon in the [[2009]] ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'' sourcebook, which became the first source to visually depict the beetle, in an [[:File:Silooth.jpg|image]] by artist [[Adam Gillespie]].<ref name="JATM" /> The creature was also mentioned in the [[2010]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="BoS" />

The silooth was originally set to be mentioned within the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article ''[[Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals]]'', by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], but the article was condensed prior to publication,<ref name="blog">{{Blog|abelgpena|78|An Old Friend: Star Wars Insider #66}}</ref> and the reference to the silooth did not make the final cut.<ref name="blog" /><ref name="cut">"[[Dirty Dozen: The Imperial Grand Admirals]]"</ref> The original draft of the article revealed that Grand [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Syn symbolically named his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] after the silooth following his conversion to the [[Church of the Dark Side]], a phony religion established shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], in honor of his new faith.<ref name="cut" /> The naming of Syn's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] as the ''Silooth'' was later [[canon]]ized by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="EGtW" />

A conflict exists regarding the number of limbs that the silooth possessed. While ''The Dark Side Sourcebook'' states that the creatures had eight legs,<ref name="TDSS" /> the images of silooth that appear in the ''Jedi Academy Training Manual'' and ''Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side'' depict them as having just six.<ref name="JATM" /><ref name="BoS" /> This article assumes that the beetles had six legs, because the latter two sources are the most recently published of the three books.
